evals.prompt: The plan in brief/02-plan.md is approved. The folder is empty, build the site.
evals.expected_output: A static site (index.html, styles.css, images/) matching the plan, with screenshots in brief/screenshots/ and a list of images in brief/media.md.
assertions: index.html exists with one h1 equal to the H1 in the plan
The order of h2s on the page matches the order of sections in the plan
brief/screenshots/ has screenshots at 375 and 1440 px, or the reply says plainly that there was no screenshot tool
No stock image has alt text or a caption suggesting it's the company's project
The visible text contains no — character
The reply contains the verification checklist with items ticked
If the page animates anything, it animates only transform and opacity, the CSS has a prefers-reduced-motion rule, and nothing moves on its own for more than 5 s without a pause control

evals.prompt: the review in brief/03-review.md has STATUS: NEEDS_CHANGES, fix what's assigned to the build
evals.expected_output: Only the items with the website-build stage are fixed; items for website-plan are reported, not patched in the code.
assertions: Only the elements listed in the fixes for website-build were changed
Fixes assigned to website-plan weren't made in the code, only reported
